# Tomtom

TomTom provides a suite of location-based services and APIs, including mapping, routing, traffic information, and geofencing, enabling developers to integrate advanced navigation and location functionalities into their applications.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/tomtom/.

## Actions

- **Calculate Route** (read-only): Calculate driving routes.
- **Category Search** (read-only): Search for points of interest by category.
- **Fuzzy Search** (read-only): Perform a fuzzy search for addresses and points of interest.
- **Map Display Static Image** (read-only): Fetch a static map snapshot given center coords and zoom.
- **Map Display WMS GetMap** (read-only): Retrieve a map image via wms getmap.
- **MAP_DISPLAY_RASTER_TILE** (read-only): Retrieve a raster map tile for specified coordinates and zoom.
- **Matrix Routing** (read-only): Calculate travel time and distance matrix between multiple locations.
- **Nearby Search** (read-only): Find points of interest near a specified location.
- **Points of Interest Search** (read-only): Search for points of interest by query.
- **Reverse Geocode** (read-only): Convert geographic coordinates into a human-readable address.
- **Structured Geocode** (read-only): Convert structured address fields into coordinates.
- **EV Charging Stations Availability** (read-only): Retrieve ev charging station availability info.
- **Flow Segment Data** (read-only): Retrieve traffic flow data for a specific road segment.
- **Get Map Copyrights** (read-only): Retrieve copyright information for a specific map tile.
- **List Assets Sprites** (read-only): List available sprites for a given asset version.
- **List Map Fonts** (read-only): List available font asset versions for map rendering.
- **List map styles** (read-only): List available map styles.
- **List Sprite Versions** (read-only): List available sprite asset versions.
- **Traffic Incidents** (read-only): Retrieve detailed traffic incidents within a bounding box.
